=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/Dockerfile.app.j2:8-10 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The Dockerfile omits `coreutils`, so `timeout` is unavailable.
  WHY: The repo-check script relies on `timeout`, so the validation container can fail with `command not found: timeout`.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/90_tap_report.sh.j2:7-15 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The synthetic TAP reporter emits its own TAP plan and results on top of the test suite output.
  WHY: That can confuse TAP consumers with duplicate test IDs and incorrect counts.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/10_family_marker.sh.j2:4 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The family marker script prints plain text instead of TAP format.
  WHY: Mixing non-TAP text into a TAP stream can break strict TAP consumers.
- .ai/validate.yml:12 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: tap_plan: 3 doesn't match the actual TAP-emitting test count.
  WHY: The reviewer counted five TAP-emitting tests, so the manifest's declared plan can disagree with execution.
- scripts/run_validation_repo_checks.sh:10 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: Potentially incorrect test file reference in the repo-check script.
  WHY: It invokes `python3 tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py`, so a missing or broken test would fail the check.
- tests/fixtures/validation_harness/python_repo_checks/tests/10_family_marker.sh | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The family marker script prints plain text instead of TAP output.
  WHY: TAP parsers expect compliant TAP records, so arbitrary text without a plan can fail validation.
- tests/fixtures/validation_harness/python_repo_checks/tests/_lib/import_audit.py:5 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `import argparse` is unused.
  WHY: The file only uses `subprocess` and `sys`, so the import is dead code.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/Dockerfile.app.j2:8-10 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Missing coreutils package installation
  WHY: `scripts/run_validation_repo_checks.sh` uses `timeout`, which is part of coreutils, so the validation container will fail with "command not found: timeout".
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/90_tap_report.sh.j2:7-15 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Duplicate synthetic TAP output
  WHY: It creates TAP plan and test results even though other tests already output TAP, which can confuse TAP parsers.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/10_family_marker.sh.j2:4 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Plain text output instead of TAP format
  WHY: Non-TAP output mixed with TAP can break TAP consumers expecting strict TAP format.
- .ai/validate.yml:12 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: tap_plan: 3 doesn't match actual test count
  WHY: The TAP plan announces 3 tests but the reviewer counted 5 TAP-emitting tests.
- scripts/run_validation_repo_checks.sh:10 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: References potentially incorrect test file
  WHY: The script runs `python3 tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py`; if the test fails or doesn't exist, the repo check fails.

  WHY: `scripts/run_validation_repo_checks.sh` invokes `timeout`, so the validation harness can fail with "command not found: timeout".
